abilities.surgesurfer.desc: Doubles this Pokémon's Speed on Electric Terrain.
abilities.surgesurfer.flavor: Doubles the Pokémon's Speed stat on Electric Terrain.
abilities.surgesurfer.name: Surge Surfer
abilities.swarm.desc: Strengthens Bug moves to inflict 1.5× damage at 1/3 max HP or less.
abilities.swarm.flavor: Powers up Bug-type moves when the Pokémon's HP is low.
abilities.swarm.name: Swarm
abilities.sweetveil.flavor: Prevents the Pokémon and its allies from falling asleep.
abilities.sweetveil.name: Sweet Veil
abilities.swiftswim.flavor: Boosts the Pokémon's Speed stat in rain.
abilities.swiftswim.name: Swift Swim
abilities.swordofruin.desc: Lowers Defense of all Pokémon except itself.
abilities.swordofruin.flavor: The power of the Pokémon's ruinous sword lowers the Defense stats of all Pokémon except itself.
abilities.swordofruin.name: Sword of Ruin
abilities.symbiosis.desc: Passes the bearer's held item to an ally when the ally uses up its item.
abilities.symbiosis.flavor: The Pokémon passes its held item to an ally that has used up an item.
abilities.symbiosis.name: Symbiosis
abilities.synchronize.desc: Copies burns, paralysis, and poison received onto the Pokémon that inflicted them.
abilities.synchronize.flavor: If the Pokémon is burned, paralyzed, or poisoned by another Pokémon, that Pokémon will be inflicted with the same status condition.
abilities.synchronize.name: Synchronize
abilities.tabletsofruin.desc: Lowers Attack of all Pokémon except itself.
abilities.tabletsofruin.flavor: The power of the Pokémon's ruinous wooden tablets lowers the Attack stats of all Pokémon except itself.
abilities.tabletsofruin.name: Tablets of Ruin
abilities.tangledfeet.flavor: Boosts the Pokémon's evasiveness if it is confused.
abilities.tangledfeet.name: Tangled Feet
abilities.tanglinghair.desc: When this Pokémon takes regular damage from a contact move, the attacking Pokémon's Speed lowers by one stage.
abilities.tanglinghair.flavor: Contact with the Pokémon lowers the attacker's Speed stat.
abilities.tanglinghair.name: Tangling Hair
abilities.technician.desc: Strengthens moves of 60 base power or less to 1.5× their power.
abilities.technician.flavor: Powers up weak moves so the Pokémon can deal more damage with them.
abilities.technician.name: Technician
abilities.telepathy.desc: Protects against friendly Pokémon's damaging moves.
abilities.telepathy.flavor: The Pokémon anticipates and dodges the attacks of its allies.
abilities.telepathy.name: Telepathy
abilities.teraformzero.desc: As soon as Terapagos assumes its Stellar Form, it will immediately neutralize weather and terrain effects.
abilities.teraformzero.flavor: When Terapagos changes into its Stellar Form, it uses its hidden powers to eliminate all effects of weather and terrain, reducing them to zero.
abilities.teraformzero.name: Teraform Zero
abilities.terashell.desc: All damage-dealing moves that hit the Pokémon when its HP is full will not be very effective.
abilities.terashell.flavor: The Pokémon's shell contains the powers of each type. All damage-dealing moves that hit the Pokémon when its HP is full will not be very effective.
abilities.terashell.name: Tera Shell
abilities.terashift.desc: When Terapagos enters the battle, it turns into its Terastal Form until the end of the battle.
abilities.terashift.flavor: When the Pokémon enters a battle, it absorbs the energy around itself and transforms into its Terastal Form.
abilities.terashift.name: Tera Shift
abilities.teravolt.desc: Bypasses targets' abilities if they could hinder or prevent moves.
abilities.teravolt.flavor: The Pokémon's moves are unimpeded by the Ability of the target.
abilities.teravolt.name: Teravolt
abilities.thermalexchange.desc: Raises Attack when hit by a Fire-type move. Cannot be burned.
abilities.thermalexchange.flavor: Boosts the Attack stat when the Pokémon is hit by a Fire-type move. The Pokémon also cannot be burned.
abilities.thermalexchange.name: Thermal Exchange
abilities.thickfat.desc: Halves damage from Fire and Ice moves.
abilities.thickfat.flavor: The Pokémon is protected by a layer of thick fat, which halves the damage taken from Fire- and Ice-type moves.
abilities.thickfat.name: Thick Fat
abilities.tintedlens.desc: Doubles damage inflicted with not-very-effective moves.
abilities.tintedlens.flavor: The Pokémon can use “not very effective” moves to deal regular damage.
abilities.tintedlens.name: Tinted Lens
abilities.torrent.desc: Strengthens Water moves to inflict 1.5× damage at 1/3 max HP or less.
abilities.torrent.flavor: Powers up Water-type moves when the Pokémon's HP is low.
abilities.torrent.name: Torrent
abilities.toughclaws.desc: Strengthens moves that make contact to 1.33× their power.
abilities.toughclaws.flavor: Powers up moves that make direct contact.
abilities.toughclaws.name: Tough Claws
abilities.toxicboost.flavor: Powers up physical moves when the Pokémon is poisoned.
abilities.toxicboost.name: Toxic Boost
abilities.toxicchain.desc: May cause bad poisoning when the Pokémon hits an opponent with a move.
abilities.toxicchain.flavor: The power of the Pokémon's toxic chain may badly poison any target the Pokémon hits with a move
abilities.toxicchain.name: Toxic Chain
abilities.toxicdebris.desc: Scatters poison spikes at the feet of the opposing team when the Pokémon takes damage from physical moves.
abilities.toxicdebris.flavor: Scatters poison spikes at the feet of the opposing team when the Pokémon takes damage from physical moves.
abilities.toxicdebris.name: Toxic Debris
abilities.trace.desc: Copies an opponent's ability upon entering battle.
abilities.trace.flavor: When it enters a battle, the Pokémon copies an opposing Pokémon's Ability.
abilities.trace.name: Trace
abilities.transistor.name: Transistor
abilities.triage.desc: This Pokémon's healing moves have their priority increased by 3.
abilities.triage.flavor: Gives priority to the Pokémon's healing moves.
abilities.triage.name: Triage
abilities.truant.flavor: Each time the Pokémon uses a move, it spends the next turn loafing around.
abilities.truant.name: Truant
abilities.turboblaze.desc: Bypasses targets' abilities if they could hinder or prevent moves.
abilities.turboblaze.flavor: The Pokémon's moves are unimpeded by the Ability of the target.
abilities.turboblaze.name: Turboblaze
abilities.unaware.desc: Ignores other Pokémon's stat modifiers for damage and accuracy calculation.
abilities.unaware.flavor: When attacking, the Pokémon ignores the target's stat changes.
abilities.unaware.name: Unaware
abilities.unburden.desc: Doubles Speed upon using or losing a held item.
abilities.unburden.flavor: Boosts the Speed stat if the Pokémon's held item is used or lost.
abilities.unburden.name: Unburden
abilities.unnerve.desc: Prevents opposing Pokémon from eating held Berries.
abilities.unnerve.flavor: Unnerves opposing Pokémon and makes them unable to eat Berries.
abilities.unnerve.name: Unnerve
abilities.unseenfist.desc: Contact moves can strike through Protect/Detect.
abilities.unseenfist.flavor: If the Pokémon uses moves that make direct contact, it can attack the target even if the target protects itself.
abilities.unseenfist.name: Unseen Fist
abilities.vesselofruin.desc: Lowers Special Attack of all Pokémon except itself.
abilities.vesselofruin.flavor: The power of the Pokémon's ruinous vessel lowers the Sp. Atk stats of all Pokémon except itself.
abilities.vesselofruin.name: Vessel of Ruin
abilities.victorystar.desc: Increases moves' accuracy to 1.1× for friendly Pokémon.
abilities.victorystar.flavor: Boosts the accuracy of its allies and itself.
abilities.victorystar.name: Victory Star
abilities.vitalspirit.flavor: The Pokémon is full of vitality, and that prevents it from falling asleep.
abilities.vitalspirit.name: Vital Spirit
abilities.voltabsorb.desc: Absorbs Electric moves, healing for 1/4 max HP.
abilities.voltabsorb.flavor: If hit by an Electric-type move, the Pokémon has its HP restored instead of taking damage.
abilities.voltabsorb.name: Volt Absorb
abilities.wanderingspirit.desc: Swaps abilities with opponents on contact.
abilities.wanderingspirit.flavor: The Pokémon exchanges Abilities with a Pokémon that hits it with a move that makes direct contact.
abilities.wanderingspirit.name: Wandering Spirit
abilities.waterabsorb.desc: Absorbs Water moves, healing for 1/4 max HP.
abilities.waterabsorb.flavor: If hit by a Water-type move, the Pokémon has its HP restored instead of taking damage.
abilities.waterabsorb.name: Water Absorb
abilities.waterbubble.desc: Halves damage from Fire moves, doubles damage of Water moves, and prevents burns.
abilities.waterbubble.flavor: Lowers the power of Fire-type moves that hit the Pokémon and prevents it from being burned.
abilities.waterbubble.name: Water Bubble
abilities.watercompaction.desc: Raises this Pokémon's Defense by two stages when it's hit by a Water move.
abilities.watercompaction.flavor: Boosts the Defense stat sharply when the Pokémon is hit by a Water-type move.
abilities.watercompaction.name: Water Compaction
abilities.waterveil.flavor: The Pokémon's water veil prevents it from being burned.
abilities.waterveil.name: Water Veil
abilities.weakarmor.desc: Raises Speed and lowers Defense by one stage each upon being hit by a physical move.
abilities.weakarmor.flavor: The Pokémon's Defense stat is lowered when it takes damage from physical moves, but its Speed stat is sharply boosted.
abilities.weakarmor.name: Weak Armor
abilities.wellbakedbody.desc: Immune to Fire-type moves, and Defense is sharply boosted.
abilities.wellbakedbody.flavor: The Pokémon takes no damage when hit by Fire-type moves. Instead, its Defense stat is sharply boosted.
abilities.wellbakedbody.name: Well-Baked Body
abilities.whitesmoke.desc: Prevents stats from being lowered by other Pokémon.
abilities.whitesmoke.flavor: The Pokémon is protected by its white smoke, which prevents other Pokémon from lowering its stats.
abilities.whitesmoke.name: White Smoke
abilities.wimpout.desc: This Pokémon automatically switches out when its HP drops below half.
abilities.wimpout.flavor: The Pokémon cowardly switches out when its HP becomes half or less.
abilities.wimpout.name: Wimp Out
abilities.windpower.desc: When hit by a wind move, the power of the next Electric-type move it uses is doubled.
abilities.windpower.flavor: The Pokémon becomes charged when it is hit by a wind move, boosting the power of the next Electric-type move the Pokémon uses.
abilities.windpower.name: Wind Power
abilities.windrider.desc: Gives immunity to wind moves, and causes the Pokémon's Attack to increase by one stage when hit by one.
abilities.windrider.flavor: Boosts the Pokémon's Attack stat if Tailwind takes effect or if the Pokémon is hit by a wind move. The Pokémon also takes no damage from wind moves.
abilities.windrider.name: Wind Rider
abilities.wonderguard.desc: Protects against damaging moves that are not super effective.
abilities.wonderguard.flavor: Its mysterious power only lets supereffective moves hit the Pokémon.
abilities.wonderguard.name: Wonder Guard
abilities.wonderskin.desc: Lowers incoming non-damaging moves' base accuracy to exactly 50%.
abilities.wonderskin.flavor: Makes status moves more likely to miss the Pokémon.
abilities.wonderskin.name: Wonder Skin
abilities.zenmode.desc: Changes Darmanitan's form after each turn depending on its HP: Zen Mode below 50% max HP, and Standard Mode otherwise.
abilities.zenmode.flavor: Changes the Pokémon’s shape when HP is half or less.
abilities.zenmode.name: Zen Mode
abilities.zerotohero.desc: Transforms into its Hero Form when switching out.
abilities.zerotohero.flavor: The Pokémon transforms into its Hero Form when it switches out.
abilities.zerotohero.name: Zero to Hero
